question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: Diffident
solution:
The correct answer is: **Timid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"diffident"** means someone who is shy, lacking self-confidence, or reserved in nature. (संकोची, आत्मविश्वासहीन)

 

 
• **Example: **She was diffident about sharing her opinions during the meeting, fearing criticism.

 

 

 
• **"Timid"** refers to someone who is shy, easily frightened, or lacking courage. (डरपोक)

 

 
• **Example: **The timid child hid behind his mother when strangers arrived.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'diffident' **is **'timid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Timid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confident **(आत्मविश्वासी): Someone who is sure of themselves or their abilities.

 

 
• **Example:** She was confident about her performance in the final exam.

 

 

 
• **Bold **(साहसी): Someone who is courageous, daring, or not afraid to take risks.

 

 
• **Example: **He made a bold decision to leave his stable job and start his own business.

 

 

 
• **Assertive** (आत्मविश्वासपूर्ण): Someone who expresses their opinions or needs confidently without being aggressive.

 

 
• **Example:** She is assertive in her communication, ensuring her ideas are clearly heard and understood.

 

 

38:T6b9,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
